task.description:
WF-05 Step 2a-sr: Evaluate the UAT report for the SwiftRoute tenant onboarding process. Speak as Alice Bauer (CEO) and Marco Stein (Operations Manager).

Read the UAT report at tests/uat-reports/uat-2026-06-16-WF05-swiftroute-onboarding.yaml and the scenario at tests/simulation/scenarios/swiftroute-tenant-onboarding-happy.yaml.

Evaluate from a business perspective:
- Did SwiftRoute get its own isolated workspace (realm) as expected?
- Can Alice log in immediately?
- Is the hostname registered?
- Is there evidence of tenant isolation?
- Are there any concerns from a logistics operations perspective?

Write sign-off to tests/uat-reports/bo-signoff-swiftroute-WF05-swiftroute-onboarding-uat-20260616.yaml.

Vote APPROVED or OBJECTED per outcome. Overall: APPROVED if no BLOCKER issues.
acceptance_criteria: Each EO evaluated from business perspective

result.summary: SwiftRoute BO sign-off APPROVED. All five onboarding outcomes (EO-001 to EO-005) meet business expectations. Alice Bauer can log in immediately, workspace is isolated, hostname is registered, and provisioning completed without manual intervention.
result.next_action: Route to PRODUCT-OWNER after all three BO sign-offs complete
